verdict.rationale: A probe confirms GitLab documents an official CLI on its own docs site, so the core capability exists. Nothing in the pack describes what the CLI does or how it fits AI-native or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: details of CLI commands and coverage, evidence of AI/agent-oriented CLI usage, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
